hero.subtitle: FPO-Updated RBC Capital Markets' multi-asset trading platform is the only solution that keeps intelligence connected from decision to execution.

body: FPO-Updated Trading desks are evolving, and the gap between real-time intelligence and multi-asset execution is closing fast.

FPO-Updated Many platforms help you analyze the trade. MAAS, RBC's Multi-Asset Agency Solutions platform, goes further, bringing trading intelligence and execution technology into one unified experience.
FPO-Updated Because in complex markets, the traders who win aren't just faster — they're better informed, better connected, and better positioned to execute.
